jobs.title: Site Contracts Manager
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is looking for a Site Contracts Manager to join our European Team. Position Summary: Review, draft, negotiate and track a variety of legal agreements including confidentiality agreements, master confidentiality agreements, clinical study agreements and amendment agreements. Work with supervisor and various internal/external key stakeholders to resolve/escalate contractual issues. Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures and contracting standards. Update relevant study team members regarding the status of contract negotiations and execution. Establish, track, report and manage site contract metrics. Support the maintenance of contract files and databases, including contract archiving. Assist in designing and implementing policies and procedures to affect the timely execution of contracts. Recognize where processes can be improved and take corrective action. Other tasks as assigned. Qualifications: Minimum Required: Graduate, postgraduate, 4-year college degree Experience in a CRO/healthcare field Relevant experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating site Clinical Trial Agreements, Vendor Contracts and Site Budget negotiations, but no less than 5 years’ experience. jobs.description: RULEMATCH has built a digital assets trading and clearing venue with world-class partners to meet the specific needs of regulated financial institutions. By offering significantly more capital-efficient and lower latency trading, RULEMATCH is helping increase institutional adoption and enable the next evolution of the crypto and digital asset market. Tasks Take ownership of the ongoing monitoring, maintenance and enhancement of the AML/CFT framework to ensure compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Develop, draft, review and maintain internal AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls. Oversee and perform AML/CFT compliance operations, including participant onboarding, KYC and due diligence. Ensure appropriate documentation and lifecycle management of participant relationships. Support regulatory matters, including the preparation of documentation, responses and information required by supervisory authorities. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to embed a strong compliance culture and deliver AML/CFT training across the organisation.
